newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S COMBINED WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S COMBINED WINNER.

text.p: The following is a profile of the winner of Thursday's men's combined event at the Alpine skiing world championships:

World Cup wins: 13. Giant slalom - Adelboden (97), Vail (94), Hinterstoder (94), Are (93), Oppdal (93), Sestriere (92), Super-G - Lillehamer (96), Are (93), Kvitfjell (93), Aspen (93), Aspen (92), Downhill - Chamonix (94), Combined - Chamonix (94)

Other facts: Norway's most decorated Alpine skier. Dominated the 1993 world championships in Morioka, Japan winning gold in the slalom and giant slalom and taking silver in the combined. Claimed Olympic gold in the super-G in 1992 in Albertville. At the 1994 Olympics in Lillehammer collected silver in the downhill and combined and bronze in the super-G. The 1994 overall World Cup champion. Multiple junior world champion in 1990.
